notes.title: LOP at TGS 2021!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

We are so pleased to announce that LOP is at Tokyo Game Show 2021.

It's been a few weeks since Steam Next Fest: June 2021, and we've been worked hard on the game to update the game for this event. The intro scene has been added, and some UI is improved. Please check the demo, and feel free to tell us your impression! All feedback will be really helpful to make the game better.

We don't meet in person, but we can still talk about the games. Please visit our Discord channel!
Discord: https://discord.com/invite/rbNrc8MWpS
You can also follow us on Twitter and Facebook for the latest updates.
Twitter: https://twitter.com/magiccubegames
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/magiccube
We hope that you enjoy TGS and the updated demo.

Thanks!

notes.title: Join us on Discord!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40305747/3833b44ebcdbe1979f58921c74e80e48fc49a2e1.png[/img]

Hello!

The official Discord has just opened! We're looking forward to hearing your thought about the game. Feel free to leave feedback, questions, and chat about the game. 
Discord: https://discord.gg/rbNrc8MWpS

You can also check the news also on:
Twitter: https://twitter.com/magiccubegames
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/magiccube
Youtube: https://www.youtube.com/user/MagicCubeGames
Website: http://magiccubegames.com/

And of course, we'll continue to keep post the progress of development here too. We're working hard to polish the game. The feedback we received during the Steam Next Fest was so helpful for us. We can't wait to meet you again. We'll be back soon with the Lord of the parties!

Thanks!

notes.title: The Lord of the Parties Live Q&A with Devs
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40305747/847f4bc66599650f68f0582018368bd024879ce4.jpg[/img]
We are planning on live Q&A with devs at Steam Next Fest 2021.
We are going to talk about the rules, several modes that the full game includes, and future update plans while playing the game. Also, We will be doing Q&A on the chat, so don't miss out!
